headline: Ryman Hospitality Properties, Inc. to Acquire Grande Lakes Orlando Resort for $1.38 Billion
summary: NASHVILLE, Tenn., Aug. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ryman Hospitality Properties, Inc. (NYSE: RHP) (the “Company”), a lodging real estate investment trust (“REIT”) specializing in group-oriented, upscale convention center resorts and entertainment experiences, today announced a definitive agreement under which the Company will purchase the fee simple interest in Grande Lakes Orlando Resort (“Grande Lakes” or the “Property”) in Orlando, Florida, for $1.38 billion from Trinity Investments.
